# MotelyJAML — Copilot Instructions

Balatro seed-filter engine. JAML (Jimbo's Ante Markup Language) is a YAML-based DSL describing which Balatro seeds satisfy joker/boss/item/tag criteria. The C# core compiles JAML into SIMD-vectorized seed filters; the repo also ships editor tooling (LSP + VS Code extension + Monaco).

**Not in this repo:** the MCP server / MCP Apps UI (moved to `**seedfinder.app`**, deployed at `https://mcp.seedfinder.app/mcp`) and the `jaml-ui` TS/React package (its own repo). They consume the published `motely-wasm` npm package like any other external client.

## Architecture

```
Motely/                      # Core C# filtering engine — SIMD, JAML compilation
Motely.CLI/                  # NativeAOT CLI (Linux/Windows x64) with AVX/AVX-512
Motely.Wasm/                 # Bootsharp WASM → publishes motely-wasm npm (NativeAOT-LLVM, embedded binaries)
Motely.TUI/                  # Terminal.Gui UI (Linux-targeted; maintenance-mode, not actively updated)
Motely.DistributedWorker/    # Pool worker for distributed search
Motely.HelperAPI/            # Auxiliary REST API
Motely.DB/                   # DuckDB interface; Motely.DB.Browser for WASM variant
Motely.Tests/                # xunit test suite (net10.0)
Motely.TestWebsite/          # Vite demo site (vanilla JS) exercising motely-wasm
tools/jaml-language/         # TypeScript workspace: core | lsp-server | vscode-extension | monaco | jaml-schema
Seeds/                       # DuckLake of seed data (Seeds/ducklake)
JamlFilters/                 # User/example .jaml filter library
```

`tools/balatro-seed-finder/` is a **migration stub** pointing to `seedfinder.app`. It is not part of the pnpm workspace, is not built, and must not be treated as active code.

**Version:** set in `Directory.Packages.props` as `<MotelyVersion>` (check the file for the current value — do not hardcode here).  
**Target framework:** net10.0 across the entire solution. `Motely.Wasm` adds `<RuntimeIdentifier>browser-wasm</RuntimeIdentifier>` (NativeAOT-LLVM + Bootsharp) — it is **not** a separate `net10.0-browser` TFM.

## Build & Test

```powershell
# Individual steps
dotnet build Motely.sln -c Release
dotnet publish Motely.Wasm -c Release
dotnet test Motely.sln
dotnet run --project Motely.CLI -- --write-jaml-schema   # regenerate jaml.schema.json
```

```bash
# JS/TS tooling (tools/jaml-language/)
cd tools/jaml-language && pnpm install && pnpm build
pnpm dev:lsp        # watch LSP server
pnpm dev:vscode     # watch VS Code extension

# Root npm scripts (repo root)
pnpm install
pnpm dev                                # Motely.TestWebsite dev server (binds Vite to that package)
```

## Key Conventions

- **SIMD-first**: Core search uses `MotelyVectorSearchContext` (8 seeds/cycle via AVX/AVX2/AVX-512). Single-seed analysis uses `MotelySingleSearchContext` (partial classes per domain).
- **NativeAOT safety**: Trim-safe via `TrimmerRoots.xml`; use `Vecc.YamlDotNet.Analyzers.StaticGenerator` for YamlDotNet source gen. Don't add reflection-heavy patterns to core/CLI.
- **JAML schema is generated**: `jaml.schema.json` at root and `public/jaml.schema.json` are generated by CLI — do not edit manually.
- **motely-wasm npm:** Single browser package, emitted from `Motely.Wasm` publish into the `motely-wasm/` sibling directory (controlled by `<BootsharpPublishDirectory>` in the csproj). `motely-wasm/package.json` is hand-authored with full npm metadata; Bootsharp only emits a default if absent (`Bootsharp.targets` condition `!Exists`). Version is synced from `<MotelyVersion>` at `npm pack`/`npm publish` by the `prepack` lifecycle hook running `sync-version.mjs`. There is no `motely-wasm-compat` sibling package.
- **Bootsharp interop:** Exported surface is a **single** `[JSExport]` interface — `Motely.IMotelyWasm` (see `[Motely.Wasm/README.md](../Motely.Wasm/README.md)`). Never call one `[JSExport]` method from another on `this`; use `private` helpers. Follow `D:\bootsharp\docs` for all interop patterns.
- **Threading:** All WASM search methods set `.WithThreadCount(1)`. Browser WASM is single-threaded; thread count is not a parameter.
- **JAML is JAML.** It is YAML-based but is its own language — refer to it as JAML, not YAML. Parse with the `yaml` npm package on the JS side, or call `MotelyWasm.validateJaml` / `MotelyWasm.validateJamlStructured`. Never regex-parse JAML.
- **Published TS consumers live elsewhere:** `jaml-ui` (React + shared Motely/JAML TS surface) and `jimbo-ui` (Balatro-themed visual components) are the canonical npm wrappers over `motely-wasm`. Downstream apps must consume those packages — **not** re-implement display-name / enum / parsing logic. If an export appears missing, the fix is adding it to `IMotelyWasm` (this repo), not working around it in TS.
- **One package ("compat" shape):** single embedded-binaries `motely-wasm/index.mjs` (~10–11 MB). Do **not** reintroduce a separate `motely-wasm-compat` sibling.
- **Database**: DuckDB via `Motely.DB`. Browser variant (`Motely.DB.Browser`) uses duckdb-reader.js interop.
- **JAML syntax source of truth**: `Motely/Filters/Jaml/JamlConfig.cs` and the generated `jaml.schema.json` define the full root/clause/source key surface. Downstream consumers (language tooling, external MCP) must re-sync when `JamlClauseDto`, `JamlSourcesDto`, or `JamlSchemaGenerator` change.
- **Jummy**: compact alternative syntax for JAML (compiled by `JummyCompiler`). Tests in `JummyCompilerTests.cs`.
- **Test filters**: `.jaml` files under `Motely.Tests/filters/` are copied to test output and used for regression.
- **VS Code extension versioning** is **independent of `<MotelyVersion>`**. Only its `"motely-wasm"` dependency range tracks the engine cut; the extension's own `version` moves on its own schedule (see `tools/jaml-language/vscode-extension/package.json`).

## Key Files


| Purpose                     | Path                                                                    |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| JAML JSON schema            | `jaml.schema.json`                                                      |
| WASM interop contract       | `Motely/IMotelyWasm.cs` (interface) + `Motely/MotelyWasmHost.cs` (impl) |
| WASM bootstrap              | `Motely.Wasm/Program.cs` (`[JSExport(typeof(IMotelyWasm))]`)            |
| Generated TS bindings       | `motely-wasm/types/bindings.g.d.ts`                                     |
| Core JAML token definitions | `tools/jaml-language/core/src/index.ts`                                 |
| LSP server                  | `tools/jaml-language/lsp-server/`                                       |
| VS Code extension entry     | `tools/jaml-language/vscode-extension/src/extension.ts`                 |
| Vector search               | `Motely/MotelyVectorSearchContext.cs`                                   |
| Single-seed search          | `Motely/MotelySingleSearchContext.cs`                                   |
| JAML config / loader        | `Motely/Filters/Jaml/JamlConfig.cs`                                     |
| Display-name formatting     | `Motely/FormatUtils.cs`                                                 |
| Package versions            | `Directory.Packages.props` (`<MotelyVersion>`)                          |
| Shared build props          | `Directory.Build.props`                                                 |
| Local integration tests     | `Motely.Wasm/e2e/local-test.mjs` (28 assertions, covers shop items, search, schema) |


## Tooling Notes

- `agent-prefs.json` (`.llms/agent-prefs.json`) declares this workspace is used with **claude-code** and **cursor**.
- VS Code extension debug: open `tools/jaml-language/vscode-extension` and press `F5`.
- Extend JAML keyword coverage in `tools/jaml-language/core/src/index.ts`.
- Live demo: [https://optimuspi.github.io/MotelyJAML/](https://optimuspi.github.io/MotelyJAML/)
- CDN mirror (served alongside `jammy.seedfinder.app` / `mcp.seedfinder.app`): `https://cdn.seedfinder.app/motely-wasm/<version>/index.mjs` and `https://cdn.seedfinder.app/motely-wasm/latest/index.mjs`. Free fallbacks: `https://unpkg.com/motely-wasm@<version>/index.mjs` and `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/motely-wasm@<version>/index.mjs`.
